label: def:grobner-shirshov-basis
title: Groebner--Shirshov basis
html:
A Groebner--Shirshov basis for \mathrm{Dist}(G) provides a normal-form basis for the relations of the distribution algebra. The composition lemma guarantees that the leading monomials of the q-Serre relations provide non-overlapping obstructions, yielding a normal-form basis coinciding with the Lusztig divided-power basis.

The key property is confluence: a reduction map \mathrm{reduce} \colon \mathrm{Dist}(G) \to \mathrm{NF} satisfying \mathrm{reduce} \circ \mathrm{embed} \circ \mathrm{reduce} = \mathrm{reduce}, ensuring that all S-polynomials of leading monomials reduce to zero.

Reference: [fred2005], Proposition 3.8.
